messages:
Gwen: Quick sync  planning a tight copy microtest for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing heroes next week. Objective: increase meaningful signups + segment inbound into trial vs sales. whos in?
Haruto: in. propose two headline themes per product: engineer-focused (fast to prod) and procurement-focused (SLA/security).
Selena: Ill own the webinar banner and inbound routing. want the webinar CTA to go to a separate list so growth can target registrants.
Dmitri: product check  Dedicated needs 'reserved GPUs' + SLA mention. Private needs KMS + audit log callout. Hosted should call out 'curated models' and fast SDKs. keep it factual.
Caleb: CTA matrix idea: Hosted -> Start free trial; Dedicated -> Request capacity (short qual); Private -> Contact sales. Webinar -> Save my seat (separate). add utm_campaign=copy_microtest_march2026.
Selena: routing snippet for HubSpot (will implement):
```
hosted_form -> list: lp_hosted_trial_5182; lead_source=copy_microtest_5182
dedicated_form -> list: lp_dedicated_inquiry_5182; lead_source=copy_microtest_5182
private_form -> list: lp_private_sales_5182; lead_source=copy_microtest_5182
webinar_form -> list: webinar_registrants_5182; lead_source=copy_microtest_5182_banner
```
Gwen: experiment plan: 2 tones x 3 pages = 6 variants. run 72 hrs even split, then keep top 2 per page for another week. KPIs: CTR, form submit rate, qualified lead %. Calibrate weights after 72 hrs.
Haruto: copy constraints: headline <=9 words, subhead 1 sentence, CTA text (<=3 words), microcopy under CTA (privacy/trial), 1 feature chip (<=30 chars). avoid hype.
Dmitri: Dedicated qual fields: desired qps, monthly token estimate, region. map >250M tokens to AE queue. Private form add security contact + compliance checkbox.
Caleb: LinkBot, can you create tracking links and staging hooks for the three pages?
LinkBot: created links: https://rwd.test/track/h5182 (hosted), https://rwd.test/track/d5182 (dedicated), https://rwd.test/track/p5182 (private), webinar: https://rwd.test/track/w5182. Webhooks scheduled Wed 09:00 PT. :robot_face:
Selena: timeline: copy drafts by Tue noon, internal review Tue 15:00, staging Wed, launch Thu 08:00 PT. owners: Gwen (experiment), Haruto (tone variants), Selena (routing + webinar), Dmitri (product signoff), Caleb (tracking).
Gwen: baseline metrics please so we can report lift. small ask: include one measurable goal per variant (e.g., +0.5% CTR or +10% qualified leads).
Selena: pulling baseline now: Hosted CTR 3.2%, Dedicated CTR 1.1%, Private CTR 0.7%, webinar banner CTR 0.9%. posting to the channel.
Haruto: will share first drafts by 16:00 PT. keep feedback short and direct.
Gwen: nice. reconvene Thu 09:15 PT to review winners. :white_check_mark:
